data.name: FMM_001
data.value: The sludge is stirring everywhere...[pause=15] Something has been tailing us since the relay.

data.name: FMM_002
data.value: (The marsh wasn't asleep.[pause=15] It was waiting for us to wade inside.)

data.name: FMM_003
data.value: The marsh hunger has two maws.[pause=20] Cross its fangs,[pause=10] or feed it.

data.name: FMM_004
data.value: A Swalot![pause=15] It just crawled out of the sludge!

data.name: FMM_005
data.value: And a Toxicroak![pause=15] Its venom is dripping...

data.name: FMM_006
data.value: Fresh meat, rarely this willing...[pause=15] The marsh shall be fed.

data.name: FMM_007
data.value: The marsh keeps whatever it is given.[pause=15] You shall not leave.

data.name: FMM_008
data.value: Nice welcome![pause=15] We're not game![pause=10] {0},[pause=10] let's show them!

data.name: FMM_009
data.value: The two maws are still wide open.[pause=15] Let's shut them this time!

data.name: FMM_010
data.value: Glp...[pause=20] Too tough for our stomachs.

data.name: FMM_011
data.value: The marsh spat you out.[pause=15] Enjoy it,[pause=10] it never happens twice.

data.name: FMM_012
data.value: The crossing is behind us...[pause=15] Swampert's berth must be at the end!

data.name: FMM_013
data.value: (Hunger drives them, not wickedness.[pause=15] The marsh commands, they obey.)

data.name: FMM_015
data.value: The sludge forgives, once.[pause=20] The next time will be the last.
